svg.title: A terminal. The command node guide.js draws a small 3D figure of Hamdan from 51 boxes: kandura, arms, head, ghutra. Then hamdan --about prints: studies data science and AI at UAEU; based United Arab Emirates; speaks Arabic and English; writes TypeScript, Python, Dart; likes software that is finished. Then hamdan --worlds prints: nine, all live.
